paragraphs.text: Magic: The Gathering: Commander's Journal is an officially licensed Commander game guide that will be published by Penguin Random House on November 3, 2026. It is priced at $25.00 US.
Build victorious decks and record your epic clashes in this guided journal for Magic: The Gathering ’s most popular format — Commander !

In the 1990s, a group of Magic: The Gathering fans created a new ruleset for the game focusing on casual, accessible, and fast-paced play. Now called Commander, this ruleset has risen from its roots as an unofficial community to become the most popular way of playing the world’s biggest collectible card game .

The Magic: The Gathering Commander’s Journal is the first official MTG paper product designed specifically for this playstyle. Containing amazing art and behind-the-scenes stories from the designers and developers who shepherded the game from its unassuming origins to the grassroots phenomenon it is today, and guided pages crafted in partnership with Wizards of the Coast to maximize at-the-table utility, the MTG Commander’s Journal is the ideal companion for every player.
